label: Kotlin Android

structure.rule: ui -> viewmodel -> domain <- data; no Android imports in domain
strings and dimensions come from resources, never literals
only for behavior that needs a device
every dependency is declared here once

notes: Gradle wrapper only (`./gradlew`); a system Gradle is never used, and the wrapper resolves dependencies on the first build.
Dependencies enter through the version catalog; a new one needs the approval in tech.md.
`local.properties`, keystores, and signing configs stay out of the repository.
`./gradlew lint` and `testDebugUnitTest` green before a task is done; `ktlintCheck` needs the ktlint Gradle plugin.
